headline: Travel Consultant
summary: Travel consultant with four years planning domestic and international trips for families, schools and companies in Northern Mindanao. I build itineraries, book flights, hotels and tours on online platforms, and advise clients on destinations I know first-hand. I turn enquiries into bookings and repeat clients.
skills: Local tourism industry contacts in Mindanao

experience.title: Travel Consultant
bullets: Plan and book about 60 trips a month for families, schools and company outings.
Build itineraries for Camiguin, Bukidnon and Siargao trips with local resorts and guides.
Book flights and hotels on online platforms and manage changes and refunds.
Turned a school field trip client into a yearly contract for four schools.

experience.title: Reservations and Ticketing Staff
experience.location: Cagayan de Oro City, Misamis Oriental
bullets: Issued airline tickets and processed hotel bookings for walk-in clients.
Answered enquiries about destinations, fares and travel documents.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Tourism Management
